# Every problem Read must report for the garden set beside this file, in order, all at once. Each
# file breaks what its name says: beet.json, gapped.json and succession.json what the schemas
# refuse, the rest what only the catalog's own checks see. crops/tomato.json is sound, and is
# reported only for sharing its names with carrot.json, which is read first.
garden/climate/CZ.json#/places/1/key: is brno: a place's key begins with its country's code, cz_
garden/climate/CZ.json#/places/2/key: cz_brno is also the key of the place at garden/climate/CZ.json#/places/0
garden/climate/CZ.json#/places/2/name/value: Brno is also the name of the place at /places/0
garden/climate/CZ.json#/places/3/location/value/latitude: is 49.123: a place is given to two decimal places
garden/climate/CZ.json#/places/4/last_spring_frost/value: 02-29 is not a day of the year
garden/climate/CZ.json#/places/5/first_autumn_frost/value: 09-31 is not a day of the year
garden/climate/CZ.json#/places/6/first_autumn_frost/value: 05-13 is not after the last spring frost, 10-02
garden/climate/CZ.json#/places/7/season_length_days/value: is 100; from 05-13 to 10-02 is 142 days
garden/climate/XX.json#/country: is SK, so the file is SK.json
garden/climate/XX.json#/places/0/key: cz_brno is also the key of the place at garden/climate/CZ.json#/places/0
garden/climate/XX.json#/places/0/key: is cz_brno: a place's key begins with its country's code, sk_

garden/crops/clover.json#/harvest_unit: is a harvest's, and a green manure is dug in, not harvested

garden/crops/rhubarb.json#/germination_temp_c: is a seed's, and the crop is not started from seed
